import Aesop

theorem power_difference_residue_excludes_fourth_zero (n : ℤ)
    (hres : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - 5 ^ 13 ≡ n [ZMOD 7]) :
    ¬ n ^ 4 ≡ 0 [ZMOD 7] := by
  intro hzero
  
  have hbase : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - 5 ^ 13 ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq]
  
  have hn_three : n ≡ (3 : ℤ) [ZMOD 7] :=
    hres.symm.trans hbase
  
  have hfour_dvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ n ^ 4 :=
    Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp hzero
  
  have hpower_as_square : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (n ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    convert hfour_dvd using 1 <;> ring
  
  have hsquare_dvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ n ^ 2 := by
    apply Int.natCast_dvd.mpr
    exact Int.Prime.dvd_natAbs_of_coe_dvd_sq (by norm_num) (n ^ 2)
      hpower_as_square
  
  have hn_dvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ n := by
    apply Int.natCast_dvd.mpr
    exact Int.Prime.dvd_natAbs_of_coe_dvd_sq (by norm_num) n hsquare_dvd

    Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr hn_dvd
  
  have hcontradiction : (3 : ℤ) ≡ 0 [ZMOD 7] :=
    hn_three.symm.trans hn_zero
